---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Duncan Temple Lang <dtemp...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Fri, Mar 7, 2014 at 12:10 PM
Subject: Informal data science/analysis course this spring quarter
To: Statistical Computing <stats...@ucdavis.edu>
Cc: Paul Baines <pdba...@ucdavis.edu>


Hi folks

[Please forward this to anyone or group on campus that might be interested.]

Paul Baines and I are going to teach an informal/unofficial
group study course next quarter.  The course is entitled

 Explorations in Data Science

We will be working in groups on actual data analysis problems.
We'll introduce and discuss statistical methods, computing technologies and approaches,
visualization in the context of solving these problems.

This is a chance for students to get hands-on experience with authentic
data problems and problem solving with data science techniques and technologies.
The course is primarily aimed at Masters and PhD students interested in Data Science from
all departments across campus.

Information about the course is available at

  http://eeyore.ucdavis.edu/ExplorationsInDataScience/Spring14/

For people considering participating, we want them to fill in a survey
to allow us estimate the number and background of those interested.

The link to the survey is

  https://docs.google.com/a/ucdavis.edu/forms/d/1AegD1xZVfoVzp4PbLxaWIORLbLpbWj-WZwvOBDOKI7U/viewform


 Thanks,

   Duncan and Paul.
